name: Welcome screen
notes: A framed stone panel for a screen's title and controls to be drawn on. Nine full frames, read left to right then down, loop to send a pulse of light clockwise round the frame.
'menuRect' is the guide's area for the title and controls, in frame pixels. Every frame is identical inside it, so text never sits on anything that moves.
'stillRect' is measured from the image: the largest area around menuRect that is also identical in every frame. Controls may spread into it if the art beneath is still clear.
Fit the whole frame inside the window (scale = the smaller of width / 1000 and height / 600), centre it, and place the controls with the same scale and offset.
'pulse' is where the light is in each frame. Frame 1 alone can be used as a still picture.
The guide says the PNG carries an 'Animation' text field; this file has none, so the timings here come from the guide.
